ja: 一九七七年、千葉県生まれ。日本大学芸術学部卒業。二〇〇九年「森崎書店の日々」で「第三回ちよだ文学賞」（主催・千代田区）の大賞を受賞する。同作品は映画化され、一〇年十月に公開。本書収録の「桃子さんの帰還」が受賞後第一作となる。
en: Born in 1977 in Chiba Prefecture. Graduated from the Nihon University College of Art. In 2009, "Days at the Morisaki Bookshop" won the grand prize of the 3rd Chiyoda Literary Prize (sponsored by Chiyoda Ward). The work was adapted into a film, released in October 2010. "The Return of Momoko-san," included in this book, is his first work since winning the prize.
